projects.title: CyberSec-Reasoner – A Three-Stage Post-Trained Reasoning LLM for Vulnerability Analysis
bullets: Engineered a domain-specialized LLM based on Qwen 3.5 (4B) designed to perform explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning for cybersecurity tasks, such as automated CVE-to-CWE mapping.

Architected a three-stage post-training pipeline featuring Knowledge-Based SFT for domain expertise, Cold Start SFT for reasoning structure, and Reinforcement Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for logical refinement.

Developed a weighted hybrid reward system (Total Reward = 0.5 · Rcwe + 0.3 · Rformat + 0.2 · Rkeyword) to optimize for classification accuracy and semantic grounding, validating the model against a 1,000-sample CVE/CWE dataset using custom rule-based metrics.

projects.title: SPIRICHAT - RAG-Based Q&A Chatbot
bullets: Developed an RAG-based chatbot system focused on answering questions about supernatural topics (e.g., ghosts, demons, vampires) by retrieving relevant context from uploaded documents and generating natural language responses using OpenAI GPT-3.5 API.
Designed the backend using Flask to handle document ingestion, context cleaning, embedding generation via Hugging Face models, vector storage with Pinecone, and response generation through LangChain.
Built a responsive, full-screen chat interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, supporting dynamic user interactions, context-aware replies, and persistent chat history across sessions.

projects.title: Drone Human Detection & Counting System – YOLO26-OBB + BoT-SORT Aerial Analytics Pipeline
bullets: Designed and implemented an end-to-end aerial computer vision pipeline using YOLO26l-OBB fine-tuned on the VisDrone2019-DET dataset for drone imagery.
Engineered a full data preprocessing and training workflow including HBB→OBB conversion, coordinate clipping, class remapping, etc.
Integrated BoT-SORT multi-object tracking for unique whole-video human counting, implemented per-image and per-video counting modules.

projects.title: Multi-lingual YouTube Comment Sentiment & Type Analysis
bullets: Designed and implemented a complete multilingual NLP pipeline centered on XLM-RoBERTa for sentiment and comment-type classification across Bangla, English, and Romanized Bangla.
Automated dataset creation using YouTube Data API and LLM-based labeling (Qwen2.5-14B) via prompt-driven JSON extraction, eliminating manual annotation.
Trained and evaluated multiple models including TF-IDF + MLP, LSTM/BiLSTM, and XLM-RoBERTa, achieving up to 76.68% sentiment and 76.05% type accuracy on test data.
Developed a FastAPI-based backend with REST endpoints and a web UI to analyze single comments or entire videos, with automated plots, and confidence visualizations.

projects.title: An Explainable Approach for Network Intrusion Detection Using Machine Learning and Deep Neural Network [BSc Thesis]
bullets: Built a weighted ensemble model for robust classification, integrating SHAP and LIME for explainability.
Analyzed the impact of synthetic data on network attack classification performance.
Achieved 97.26% accuracy on a multi-class classification task with a low false positive rate of 0.0048.

projects.title: Pre-trained Transformers for Java-Python Code Translation [BSc Direct Research]
bullets: Designed a 2-step Java-to-Python code translation pipeline using CodeT5 for initial translation and PLBART for correction and minimization.
Fine-tuned CodeT5 and PLBART models to improve syntactic and semantic accuracy in cross-language code generation.
Achieved BLEU score of 51.72 and CodeBLEU of 0.4913 with CodeT5; PLBART refinement step scored 28.92 BLEU and 0.3327 CodeBLEU.

projects.title: Bone Fracture Classification Using Deep Learning
bullets: Fine-tuned two pre-trained deep learning models—EfficientNet-B0 and VGG16—for binary classification of bone X-ray images into Fractured and Not Fractured.
Conducted performance evaluation using classification metrics, with EfficientNet-B0 achieving 99.21% accuracy, outperforming VGG16.

projects.title: Malicious URL Classification with Machine Learning
bullets: Developed a machine learning-based classifier to identify and categorize malicious URLs.
Implemented multiple traditional ML models including Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost, KNN, and a Voting Classifier.
Performed URL-based feature extraction, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning, achieving a highest accuracy of 93.80%.
